summary: Full end-to-end mobile UI test (Expo web preview, 390x844) of the KJAPP Expo Router app. Onboarding, customer login (demo autofill), customer home (map, pickup, cars-nearby, quick chips Hjem/Jobb/Sentralstasjon, 'Hvor vil du?'), destination via chip -> route review with 4 vehicle cards (ai-first/enkelt/trygg/premium), price summary, booking-confirm creating a trip (POST /api/trips/request -> navigated to /booking/<id> with status 'Søker sjåfør'), searching-cancel back to home, address search sheet (typed 'Oslo' -> 8 results), tabs history + profile (profile-payments/settings/logout present), payment-methods form (pm-add + pm-type-visa + pm-last4 + pm-save), settings toggles (notifications/trip_updates/price_alerts, PATCH succeeded), driver login (driver-login-demo-fill + driver-login-submit -> driver home) and driver online toggle — all working. Driver online toggle correctly reverts to OFF with the graceful message 'Posisjon kreves for å kjøre. Slå på i innstillinger.' because the browser geolocation permission is denied in the web preview (expected, called out in the review request). No red screens, no unhandled JS errors, no 500s observed.

issues: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Emitted from several StyleSheet blocks that use shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset (e.g. /app/frontend/app/(app)/home.tsx confirm button, likely also Button/Card components). Purely cosmetic warning under RN Web; on native this remains the correct API. Consider a Platform.select to use boxShadow on web to silence.

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Silence the RN Web 'shadow* deprecated, use boxShadow' warnings by wrapping shadow styles behind Platform.OS !== 'web' or providing a web boxShadow equivalent.

(Note, not a bug) The customer app already handles denied geolocation gracefully by falling back to Oslo center and showing 'Slå på posisjon for å se biler…'. The driver 'go online' flow also handles denial by reverting the toggle and showing 'Posisjon kreves for å kjøre.'. In native/Expo Go these will work normally.
critical_code_review_comments: All interactive elements have testIDs — nothing missing for the flows in scope.
api.ts correctly uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL with '/api' base and Bearer token injection.
home.tsx uses useFocusEffect to auto-redirect to /booking/[tripId] if an active trip exists — good UX.
402 (no payment method) is handled explicitly in home.tsx and routes to /payment-methods after ~700ms — confirmed not triggered for demo user (seeded PMs work).
seed_data_creation: None — used the pre-seeded ola@kjapp.no and sjafor@kjapp.no demo accounts. One trip was created and then cancelled during the test (state left clean).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web preview at http://localhost:3000/, backend at EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL/api. Both customer and driver flows are green end-to-end. Geolocation is denied in the browser preview: the customer flow uses Oslo fallback (booking works via quick places); the driver 'online' toggle reverts to off with a clear Norwegian error — that is expected and should not be treated as a bug. Watch for the harmless RN-Web 'shadow* deprecated' console warning.
